title: Household Size and the Water First-Block Bound — Utility Pass-Through Service Decision Table
content:
**Rule.** For the water usage charge on a Utility Pass-Through Service account, the first-block bound used is the schedule's first-block bound times the household share of the Home-Site Lease the account serves. The household share is 75 percent for a lease registering one occupant, and 150 percent (a multiplier of 1.5) for a lease registering five or more occupants. A lease registering two to four occupants takes no household share under this rule.

**Occupants** are the registered occupants of any age living in the home, as the Home-Site Lease records them.

## Decision table

| Registered occupants on the Home-Site Lease | Household share of the first-block bound |
|---|---|
| 1 | 75 percent |
| 2, 3 or 4 | none under this rule |
| 5 or more | 150 percent |

The boundary sits between four occupants (no share) and 5 occupants (150 percent).

## Resulting first-block bound (illustration from the schedule figures)

| Service schedule | Schedule's first-block bound | One occupant | Five or more occupants |
|---|---|---|---|
| Submetered Water Schedule | 4.00 kgal | 3.00 kgal | 6.00 kgal |
| Submetered Water & Sewer, Natural Gas and Propane Schedules | 3.00 kgal | 2.25 kgal | 4.50 kgal |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | 5.00 kgal | 3.75 kgal | 7.50 kgal |

**Example (hypothetical).** A single-occupant household on the Submetered Water Schedule using 5.00 kgal has 3.00 kgal priced in the first block, because its first-block bound is 4.00 times 75 percent.
